title: Daily Chief Inspector Report
contractor: West Tech Energy — Jose Salaises, Director of Operations

sections.heading: Summary of the Day
paragraphs: Joel Schweers confirmed the construction schedule with West Tech: mechanical piping and structural pipe supports and foundations (flare, pipe, guy wires) complete by December 18; platforms, I&E completion and commissioning in January. I&E may start now. Encore will send a technician to guide flare assembly and needs a few days' notice of the date.

A "Piping on Hold" meeting was scheduled and then canceled, and Tegre has found an alternate fuel gas header tie-in location (meeting accepted by Davy). West Tech asked Tegre to confirm six 5/8" flare base anchor bolts and the full setting detail. West Tech's next scatter sheet has not been received; a revised crew roster came 11/22. West Tech's 11/23 project report was sent at 17:42 (PDF not in today's sources). Construction holiday shutdown is December 20 – January 3.
